answer_1.quote: ...definition generation technique aims to automatically generate a textual definition for a target word or phrase... We propose a re‑ranking mechanism on a pre‑trained encoder‑decoder model...
answer_1.outputs: textual definitions of target words or phrases

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU as an automatic evaluation metric... we also used NIST and OOV rate... Table 3 shows BLEU and NIST scores...

answer_4.quote: We conducted a manual error analysis... We randomly sampled 200 generated definitions by T5-base and the proposed method from the Oxford dataset... annotators classified each definition into error categories.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators examined each generated definition and assigned it to one of several error categories (over‑specified, self‑reference, wrong part‑of‑speech, under‑specified, opposite, similar semantics, incorrect, correct).
